scope: Preparatory core typed syntax reply framing and direct decoded-reply proof entry. Worker publication, browser routing and both transport-adapter contracts are not yet migrated.
independentOracles: Full and retained Rust/HTML/Markdown replies reconstruct the exact existing serde Value representation
Decoded replies enter the shared proof pipeline directly and retain the expected immutable source
Long UTF-8/escaped sources, 8193-span rows, dense empty rows and maximally escaped 2 MiB sources preserve existing admission
failureContracts: Incomplete, reordered, duplicate and wrong-ticket frames
Wrong framing version, malformed and oversized frames
Source-chunk byte overflow and record declaration overflow
Poisoned decoders cannot resume or expose partial replies
Control replies require Begin and End and valid status/analysis shapes
limitations: Codec is not active in the live worker transport
Browser local/remote transport integration, failures and stale-owner contracts remain required
Complete live reply JSON decoding remains synchronous
Allocation/capacity and end-to-end responsiveness/memory measurements remain unfinished
